description: The line plot, titled "Individual vs Ensemble Models," illustrates the relationship between cost and reliability score for three different model configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Cost" and features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Reliability Score" and uses a linear scale ranging from 30 to 90, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 20. The plot contains three solid lines, each marked with circular data points at x-values of 0, 5, and 10. The yellow line, representing "GPT-4," begins at its highest point of approximately 88 at a cost of 0, and shows a steep, steady decline to approximately 68 at a cost of 5, ending at its lowest point of approximately 48 at a cost of 10. The red line, representing the "2-Model Ensemble," starts at approximately 85 at a cost of 0, declines moderately to approximately 79 at a cost of 5, and ends at approximately 73 at a cost of 10. The blue line, representing the "3-Model Ensemble," begins at approximately 82 at a cost of 0, experiences a slight decline to approximately 78 at a cost of 5, and concludes at approximately 75 at a cost of 10.
